items.name: Hongqi E-QM5
items.description: Hongqi’s fully electric executive sedan — quiet on the motorway, smooth in city traffic and surprisingly spacious in the back. A popular choice for VIP airport pickups and executive transfers.

items.name: Denza D9
items.description: The best-selling premium MPV in China — captain chairs, a quiet electric drive and a large boot. Our most requested vehicle for airport pickups and factory visits.

items.name: Voyah Dreamer
items.description: A new-generation luxury MPV with reclining second-row seats — quiet, refined and perfect for executive travel.

items.name: B-Class Sedan
items.models: BYD Han, Passat, Hongqi E-QM5, Arcfox or similar
items.description: A quiet, comfortable electric or petrol sedan — ideal for solo travellers and couples who want a smooth, economical transfer.

items.name: 7-Seat MPV
items.description: Spacious seven-seat MPV with sliding doors and a large boot — the most popular choice for families and small groups.

items.name: Mercedes-Benz V-Class
items.description: Our flagship vehicle. Leather interior, exceptional comfort and the presence you want for VIP guests and important clients.

items.name: Ford Transit 9-Seat
items.description: Nine seats and the deepest boot in the fleet — built for a whole buying team, or a factory run where the samples come back with you.

items.name: Toyota Coaster 15–23 Seats
items.description: A 15–23 seat Toyota Coaster with a high roof and a deep rear hold — the step up from the nine-seat van when the whole team, the samples and the luggage travel together. A common choice for factory visits around Foshan and Dongguan.

items.name: Yutong Coach 35–55 Seats
items.description: A 35–55 seat Yutong coach with an underfloor luggage hold — for delegations, incentive groups and trade-fair teams that need to move everyone in one vehicle. Quoted per coach, with the driver and fuel included.
